scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Poor Parents Having Only One Girl Child Who is Studying 8th to 10th Standard
other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India.
Must be a native of Puducherry by birth or continuous residence of at least five years.
Must have only one living girl child and no other children.
The girl child must be studying in 8th to 10th standard.
benefits_summary: ₹25,000 is deposited as a National Savings Certificate fixed deposit for the girl child, payable when she turns 18.
